memory.query:
SELECT task_id, attempt_id, "cluster", count(*) AS samples,
       min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts,
       max(memory_peak_mb)/1024.0 AS cumulative_host_peak_gib,
       max(memory_mb)/1024.0 AS sampled_host_peak_gib,
       max(accelerator_mem_bytes) AS reported_accelerator_mem_bytes
FROM "iris.task"
WHERE task_id='/kaiyuew@stanford.edu/ema-gram-20-polar-continuation-v5e-8-20261103/0'
  AND attempt_id=0
  AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 05:25:00'
  AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 05:40:00'
GROUP BY task_id, attempt_id, "cluster"
memory.semantics: Schema-confirmed MiB; observed cumulative host peak; hub cluster null retained.
memory.jax_limitation: Allocator accounting is not total HBM

limitations: Conditional sensitivity in separate fixed continuation executables; removing first-product computation changes compilation. Final-output agreement does not prove identical internal values. No optimizer intervention, warmed performance, trainingMFU or checkpoint restoration.

findings.reference_matches: For allq/k/v: replicated continuation with replicatedA is bitwise identical to uninstrumentedreplicated and tracedreplicated; shardedcontinuation with contractingA is bitwise identical to tracedsharded. No continuation result passes against uninstrumentedsharded.
findings.scope: Conditional A-input sensitivity and output-layout sensitivity both measured. These are not additive contributions to full optimizer error. Final equality does not establish internal identity; sharded uninstrumented reference remains unreproduced.
findings.conditional_relative_frobenius_denominat: Frobenius norm of the same fixed continuation output supplied with replicated isolated A
